name: How long does countertop replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does countertop replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of countertop replacement varies. The initial consultation and material selection can take a few days or weeks, depending on your decision-making process. Once materials are ordered, fabrication typically takes 1-3 weeks. The actual installation usually takes 1-2 days, depending on the complexity of the job and the material being installed. We provide an estimated timeline during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Countertop replacement can take several weeks from material selection to installation, with the actual installation typically lasting 1-2 days.
